59dea3472ca6ab8a24e6.en: Editing means improving your writing. Proofreading means checking for mistakes.
59dea3472ca6ab8a24e6.id: Editing berarti membuat tulisanmu lebih baik. Proofreading berarti memeriksa kesalahan.

55bcf66141327c289f07.en: Read your work aloud. If a sentence sounds wrong, look at it again.
55bcf66141327c289f07.id: Baca tulisanmu keras-keras. Kalau ada kalimat yang terdengar salah, periksa lagi.

f7385a8ddf367528fa9a.en: Check one thing at a time: capital letters, then full stops, then spelling.
f7385a8ddf367528fa9a.id: Periksa satu per satu: huruf kapital (capital letter), lalu titik (full stop), lalu ejaan.

19ff17d08a8c5612ca9e.en: Make sure verbs agree with their subjects and stay in the same tense.
19ff17d08a8c5612ca9e.id: Pastikan kata kerja sesuai dengan subjeknya dan tetap dalam tense yang sama.

c4d84fc320e159cab10a.en: Swap dull or repeated words for precise ones.
c4d84fc320e159cab10a.id: Ganti kata yang membosankan atau berulang dengan kata yang lebih tepat.

116fbb6924dbc0cf6144.en: Tomorrow has one m and two r letters.
116fbb6924dbc0cf6144.id: Tomorrow punya satu huruf m dan dua huruf r.

55d90e963b6a82a84bc9.en: My sister and I is the subject, and went agrees with it.
55d90e963b6a82a84bc9.id: My sister and I adalah subjek (subject), dan went cocok dengan subjek itu.

291a0319fd65b3efcd6e.en: The correct spelling is library, with an r after the b. It is easy to miss when you say the word quickly.
291a0319fd65b3efcd6e.id: Ejaan yang benar adalah library, dengan huruf r setelah b. Huruf itu mudah terlewat saat kamu mengucapkan kata itu dengan cepat.

9a80fb5779bd8675e0de.en: Received follows the rule i before e except after c, when the sound is ee: re-c-ei-ved.
9a80fb5779bd8675e0de.id: Received mengikuti aturan i before e except after c, saat bunyinya ee: re-c-ei-ved.

7c603b379d9cb9dcd5b7.en: Children is plural, so the verb must be plural too: the children were playing.
7c603b379d9cb9dcd5b7.id: Children berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi kata kerjanya (verb) juga harus jamak: the children were playing.

aac3ef262192dbff1c58.en: Yesterday means the past, so both verbs are in the past tense: visited and saw.
aac3ef262192dbff1c58.id: Yesterday berarti waktu yang sudah lewat, jadi kedua kata kerja (verb) memakai bentuk lampau (past tense): visited dan saw.

532ce0e06f6f93686dee.en: The match belongs to the team, so it should be their. There is about a place.
532ce0e06f6f93686dee.id: Pertandingan itu milik tim, jadi seharusnya their. There berkaitan dengan tempat.

faed9480d85537c090ad.en: Necessary, definitely and tomorrow are correct. The correct spellings of the others are separate, believe and weird.
faed9480d85537c090ad.id: Necessary, definitely, dan tomorrow itu benar. Ejaan yang benar untuk kata lainnya adalah separate, believe, dan weird.

dbbc38f106b3eebd4812.en: Nice is repeated and does not say much. Lively tells the reader exactly what the music was like.
dbbc38f106b3eebd4812.id: Nice diulang dan tidak banyak menjelaskan. Lively memberi tahu pembaca dengan jelas seperti apa musiknya.

5d262ccbe948885e181d.en: Two complete sentences usually need a full stop between them or a joining word. A comma with so joins them correctly.
5d262ccbe948885e181d.id: Dua kalimat lengkap biasanya perlu titik (full stop) di antaranya atau kata penghubung. Koma bersama so menggabungkan keduanya dengan benar.

d2b6e5475677a1b00a96.en: The correct sentence is: Every Saturday my friend and I go to the market. My friend and I is plural, so go is right.
d2b6e5475677a1b00a96.id: Kalimat yang benar adalah: Every Saturday my friend and I go to the market. My friend and I berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi go itu benar.

7e66805579e460957e63.en: Arif and I is the subject, beach is the seaside and three shells is plural. The other versions each have a mistake.
7e66805579e460957e63.id: Arif and I adalah subjek (subject), beach berarti pantai, dan three shells berbentuk jamak (plural). Versi lainnya masing-masing punya kesalahan.

02b9616e10205959d49c.en: The plural of child is children, so "childrens" is wrong.
02b9616e10205959d49c.id: Bentuk jamak dari child adalah children, jadi "childrens" itu salah.

791689526f0e1a6ed82e.en: "They're" means they are, and "their" shows ownership of the coats.
791689526f0e1a6ed82e.id: "They're" berarti they are, dan "their" menunjukkan siapa pemilik coats itu.

191168ef0bf6f722eb54.en: Definately and beech are spelling mistakes, a missing question mark or commas is punctuation, and "I seen" or "boys was" is grammar.
191168ef0bf6f722eb54.id: Definately dan beech adalah kesalahan ejaan, tanda tanya (question mark) atau koma yang hilang adalah kesalahan tanda baca, dan "I seen" atau "boys was" adalah kesalahan tata bahasa.

1277a67ef3c906a43999.en: "Go" should be "went" because the paragraph is about last Saturday.
1277a67ef3c906a43999.id: "Go" seharusnya "went" karena paragraf itu bercerita tentang Sabtu lalu.

228d596e509a159ad7d1.en: The sentence needs a capital letter, past tense "visited" and correct spelling "very".
228d596e509a159ad7d1.id: Kalimat itu perlu huruf kapital (capital letter), bentuk lampau (past tense) "visited", dan ejaan yang benar "very".

18eaef59ad3d495afd0e.en: Umbrella starts with a vowel sound, so we say "an umbrella".
18eaef59ad3d495afd0e.id: Umbrella dimulai dengan bunyi vokal, jadi kita mengucapkan "an umbrella".

dd38e831466ed582820d.en: First find the problems, then check them, correct them, and finally read again.
dd38e831466ed582820d.id: Pertama, cari masalahnya, lalu periksa, perbaiki, dan terakhir baca lagi.

eec8d2e7b7db1a1fe18a.en: Joining the ideas removes repeated words and keeps all the information.
eec8d2e7b7db1a1fe18a.id: Menggabungkan gagasan-gagasan itu menghilangkan kata yang diulang dan menjaga semua informasinya.

e829598e8215aefe4b80.en: "Their" shows that the coats belong to them. "There" is a place.
e829598e8215aefe4b80.id: "Their" menunjukkan bahwa coats itu milik mereka. "There" menunjukkan tempat.

0d478fc38c8f94b06aac.en: The bags belong to several girls and the room belongs to several teachers, so both need s'.
0d478fc38c8f94b06aac.id: Tas-tas itu milik beberapa anak perempuan dan ruangan itu milik beberapa guru, jadi keduanya perlu s'.

aa43f4caad704f9046c9.en: The correct spelling is accommodation, with double c and double m.
aa43f4caad704f9046c9.id: Ejaan yang benar adalah accommodation, dengan dua huruf c dan dua huruf m.

f9a0a15688b943ed33cb.en: The correct spellings are receive, which, their and until.
f9a0a15688b943ed33cb.id: Ejaan yang benar adalah receive, which, their, dan until.

0adabeb72eb6cce299eb.en: There are four mistakes: Dewi needs a capital, freind should be friend, too should be to, and a full stop is missing.
0adabeb72eb6cce299eb.id: Ada empat kesalahan: Dewi perlu huruf kapital (capital letter), freind seharusnya friend, too seharusnya to, dan titik (full stop) hilang.

a43f87cca899a7de98e7.en: Capital letters mark the start of sentences, as in The dog ran.
a43f87cca899a7de98e7.id: Huruf kapital (capital letter) menandai awal kalimat, seperti pada The dog ran.

e5050b8d26c057af94e8.en: With we, use were, so the sentence is We were late for school.
e5050b8d26c057af94e8.id: Dengan we, pakai were, jadi kalimatnya adalah We were late for school.

311c985e74bd2924cc04.en: The correct spelling is received. The rule is i before e except after c, when the sound is ee.
311c985e74bd2924cc04.id: Ejaan yang benar adalah received. Aturannya adalah i before e except after c, saat bunyinya ee.

422d53bb7dee0705b4d6.en: It's means it is. Its without an apostrophe shows belonging, so the sentence should say its tail.
422d53bb7dee0705b4d6.id: It's berarti it is. Its tanpa apostrof (apostrophe) menunjukkan kepemilikan, jadi kalimat itu seharusnya memakai its tail.

cd469c7ff15af0bbcdc6.en: With she, a present tense verb usually ends in s, so it should be She goes to school every day.
cd469c7ff15af0bbcdc6.id: Dengan she, kata kerja (verb) bentuk sekarang (present tense) biasanya berakhir dengan s, jadi seharusnya She goes to school every day.

e40122f9b427caab9488.en: Proofreading means checking a finished piece of writing for mistakes.
e40122f9b427caab9488.id: Proofreading berarti memeriksa tulisan yang sudah selesai untuk mencari kesalahan.

52c5b1787257e1ef3c48.en: Their shows belonging. The sentence needs they're, meaning they are.
52c5b1787257e1ef3c48.id: Their menunjukkan kepemilikan. Kalimat itu memerlukan they're, yang berarti they are.
